rules.statement: This Court is not bound to make an order under section 68 of the Courts Ordinance if the applicant can proceed under the Re-sealing Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: 'The words 'it shall be lawful' are permissive or enabling. Those who contend that an obligation exists to exercise the power conferred by such words must show in the circumstances of the case something which creates the obligation.'
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: When any person shall have died at any place out of the Island leaving property within the Island, it shall and may be lawful for the Supreme Court, or any Judge thereof, to make order directing and appointing such District Court as to the said Supreme Court, or any Judge thereof, shall appear most expedient, to have and exercise sole testamentary jurisdiction in respect of the property of the person so dying....
